title: Near and far with a sock and a soft toy

why.summary: This invitation helps your child notice near and far by moving familiar household items.
why.learning_intention: Explore near/far spatial relationships through moving objects together.

how.prep_summary: Gather one sock and one soft toy in a clear floor space. Prefer soft items to glass.
steps: Invite your child to sit or stand near you with the sock and soft toy.
Place the items near each other, then farther apart, and pause.
Invite your child to move one item nearer or farther, or to point.

before: You might try: Let's play a near and far game with a sock and a soft toy.
during: What changed when we moved it?
Can you put the toy farther away?
after: Invite your child to: Tell me which one feels nearer now.
There is no single right answer — notice what they point to or say.

constraints: Adult supervision is required for the whole activity.
No glass, choking-size objects, cords, sharp, or hot items.

adaptations.summary: Stay seated and move items only within arm's reach.
Invite pointing or looking instead of carrying objects.
Use slow tactile guidance with adult hands on soft items only.

parent_script_before: You might try: Let's play a near and far game with a sock and a soft toy.
parent_prompts_during: What changed when we moved it?
Can you put the toy farther away?
parent_prompts_after: Invite your child to: Tell me which one feels nearer now.
There is no single right answer — notice what they point to or say.
scaffold_down: Place the items yourself and invite your child to look or point only.
extend_up: You might try: Can you move the toy farther while staying seated?
observed_vs_suggested: If the child just played the in-app near/far activity, this card suggests a related off-screen invitation. It is a suggestion, not a required follow-up.
not_a_developmental_assessment: This is playful practice together — not a developmental assessment, diagnosis, or milestone check.
